entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Vasili Yevgrafovich Samarsky-Bykhovets was a Russian mining engineer and the chief of Russian Mining Engineering Corps between 1845 and 1861. The mineral samarskite, and chemical element samarium are named after him. He was the first person whose name was given to a chemical element.
